## My background 6G-LAB

* I created an experimental setup to allow for measuring the impact of diferent offloading algorithms, for this reason I had to create a very complex and fully configurale solution 
* I have decided to adapt this solution to solve the problem of ROS2 p2p connection

## ROARM Manufacturerer Demo

* **`joint_state_publisher_gui` Node:** 
  * basic slider to manipulate each joint
* **`/joint_states` Topic:** 
  * Intended joint coordinates (radian angle)
* **`serial_ctrl` Node**:
  * subscribes to `/joint_states`, 
  * radians -> hardware servo values
  * conencts to arm over serial
